hypothesis: Native-resolution lidar scarp evidence, combining slope-aware template fits with sub-pixel ridge/valley and multiscale Hessian line responses, can expose surface faults omitted from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue.
mechanism: A 1 m bare-earth DEM can preserve metre-scale slope breaks and scarp-profile curvature that are smoothed in the competition's 100 m feature stack. Cross-profile fit, line response across scales, SNR, and orientation coherence would be aggregated to the competition grid only after feature extraction.
